Supplemental legal material: provenance
======================================

All paths below are relative to META-INF/third-party/supplemental/.
References to original dependency binary entries such as META-INF/LICENSE.md
or NOTICE.markdown identify members retained under
META-INF/third-party/<groupId path>/<artifactId>/<version>/<original entry>,
with dots in groupId replaced by slashes, not the shaded jar's top-level
project LICENSE/NOTICE.
Raw legal files are preserved byte-for-byte. Source-header compilations retain
the original legal comment text and identify its source member; repeated
identical comments within an artifact are included once. No project Apache
header is added to a third-party legal text.

RUNTIME-SOURCES.tsv records the exact external runtime binary/source archives.
All external dependency versions here are releases, not Maven snapshots.
Source archive URLs use the published group/artifact/version coordinates.
SHA256SUMS records the packaged supplemental files and ../../THIRD-PARTY.txt.

Verbatim upstream legal files
----------------------------

File: dropwizard-5.0.2-NOTICE
Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dropwizard/dropwizard/v5.0.2/NOTICE

File: hibernate-validator-8.0.3.Final-COPYRIGHT.txt
Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hibernate/hibernate-validator/8.0.3.Final/copyright.txt

Excerpts and source-header compilations
--------------------------------------

metrics-4.2.39-COPYRIGHT.txt is the copyright and license notice following
the Apache-2.0 appendix in:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dropwizard/metrics/v4.2.39/LICENSE

logback-throttling-appender-1.5.3-COPYRIGHT.txt is the copyright and license
notice following the Apache-2.0 appendix in:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dropwizard/logback-throttling-appender/logback-throttling-appender-1.5.3/LICENSE

apache-source-NOTICES.txt contains unique legal comments preceding Java
package declarations from the resolved source archives of:
  org.hibernate.validator:hibernate-validator:8.0.3.Final
  org.yaml:snakeyaml:2.5
  com.google.errorprone:error_prone_annotations:2.42.0
  org.jspecify:jspecify:1.0.0
  jakarta.validation:jakarta.validation-api:3.0.2
  org.jboss.logging:jboss-logging:3.6.3.Final
  com.google.code.gson:gson:2.8.9
  com.google.j2objc:j2objc-annotations:2.8
  org.slf4j:jcl-over-slf4j:2.0.18
  org.slf4j:log4j-over-slf4j:2.0.18
It also retains the Apache-licensed comments from the Servlet 6.0.0 sources,
Javassist 3.31.0-GA's alternate-license/copyright comments, and the Apache
comments on Jersey 3.1.11's Guava, monitoring, and Hibernate-derived code.
Each excerpt names its source-archive URL and member.

argparse4j-0.9.0-NOTICES.txt contains the eight distinct leading license
comments from the resolved source archive's Java files. They cover Tatsuhiro
Tsujikawa, Adam Parkin, and Andrew January's MIT notices and the Apache
headers of FileArgumentType and TerminalWidth. Those Apache headers were
already present when those files entered the Argparse4j repository:
https://github.com/argparse4j/argparse4j/commit/2d2385e1e8a115bdb56249f1b2cbd53eb9c93bb0
https://github.com/argparse4j/argparse4j/commit/1879e7a802284274ac776f39c3de36ce389a2ae2
Source: https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/net/sourceforge/argparse4j/argparse4j/0.9.0/argparse4j-0.9.0-sources.jar

jetty-12.1.9-UnixCrypt-NOTICE.txt contains the leading comments of
org/eclipse/jetty/util/security/UnixCrypt.java, including its permission
notice and the attributed April 2001 modifications.
Source: https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/org/eclipse/jetty/jetty-util/12.1.9/jetty-util-12.1.9-sources.jar

jersey-server-3.1.11-ASM-LICENSE.txt contains the leading comment from
jersey/repackaged/org/objectweb/asm/AnnotationVisitor.java. The same
BSD-3-Clause comment is present in all 32 bundled ASM Java source files;
the preserved Jersey Server NOTICE.markdown identifies ASM 9.8.
Source: https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/org/glassfish/jersey/core/jersey-server/3.1.11/jersey-server-3.1.11-sources.jar

jersey-common-3.1.11-JSR166-NOTICE.txt contains the leading comment from
org/glassfish/jersey/internal/jsr166/Flow.java. The companion CC0 text is
the Creative Commons 1.0 legal code at the pinned upstream commit above.
Other JSR-166-derived classes with Eclipse headers retain those licenses.
Source: https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/org/glassfish/jersey/core/jersey-common/3.1.11/jersey-common-3.1.11-sources.jar

jsr305-3.0.2-NOTICES.txt retains the common leading CC-BY-2.5 comment from
javax/annotation/concurrent/GuardedBy.java, Immutable.java,
NotThreadSafe.java, and ThreadSafe.java in the resolved source archive.
Source: https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/com/google/code/findbugs/jsr305/3.0.2/jsr305-3.0.2-sources.jar

jsr305-3.0.2-origin-LICENSE is the unchanged member
jsr-305/trunk/ri/LICENSE of the original project's archived sources:
https://storage.googleapis.com/google-code-archive-source/v2/code.google.com/jsr-305/source-archive.zip
Archive SHA-256: 4f29730ba2229df8af699ee139486bf5593052d2fcc2bd0fc3cfe121fd76025b
The archive's annotation sources were compared with the resolved 3.0.2
sources: the original RI code is present, with later documentation/code
changes. This archive is an origin record, not a substitute for the exact
3.0.2 source archive. Its BSD notice and the explicit CC-BY source headers
are retained in addition to the Apache license declared by the published
3.0.2 POM.

jna-5.14.0-native-NOTICES.txt retains distinct native license comments
from the JNA 5.14.0 source tree:
https://github.com/java-native-access/jna/tree/5.14.0/native
Each excerpt gives its exact raw source URL. The source selection is the
JNA dispatch/callback C headers and libffi's common sources, headers, and
the aarch64, arm, loongarch64, mips, powerpc, riscv, s390, sparc, and x86
directories corresponding to platforms present in jna-jpms-5.14.0.jar.
Darwin PowerPC assembly and Windows ARM32 assembly are excluded because
those platforms are absent. Build tools, tests, and documentation are
excluded. The dlmalloc public-domain statement is copied without its
unrelated implementation documentation. The snapshot identifies libffi
3.4.4 in configure.ac:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/java-native-access/jna/5.14.0/native/libffi/configure.ac
This describes the legal notices in the JNA release's native source tree;
it does not claim to reconstruct each prebuilt native library's toolchain.

Apache license evidence where no additional project NOTICE is supplied
---------------------------------------------------------------------

Dropwizard's project license and Metrics/appender license appendices:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dropwizard/dropwizard/v5.0.2/LICENSE
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dropwizard/metrics/v4.2.39/LICENSE
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dropwizard/logback-throttling-appender/logback-throttling-appender-1.5.3/LICENSE

The following version-specific upstream files corroborate the Apache
source comments or supply the license for sources without file headers:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hibernate/hibernate-validator/8.0.3.Final/license.txt
https://api.bitbucket.org/2.0/repositories/snakeyaml/snakeyaml/src/snakeyaml-2.5/LICENSE.txt
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/error-prone/v2.42.0/COPYING
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jspecify/jspecify/v1.0.0/LICENSE
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jakartaee/validation/3.0.2/license.txt
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jboss-logging/jboss-logging/v3.6.3.Final/LICENSE.txt
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/gson/gson-parent-2.8.9/LICENSE
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/j2objc/2.8/LICENSE
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FasterXML/jackson-modules-base/jackson-modules-base-2.21.4/LICENSE
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qos-ch/slf4j/v_2.0.18/jcl-over-slf4j/LICENSE.txt
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qos-ch/slf4j/v_2.0.18/log4j-over-slf4j/LICENSE.txt

The two SLF4J bridge module licenses and their resolved source headers
specify Apache-2.0 even though their binary jars contain the generic
SLF4J MIT LICENSE.txt. Both the original binary metadata and the source
notices are preserved; the complete Apache text is in META-INF/LICENSE.

The two supplied Protobuf 4.32.1 license files, outside this supplemental
directory, come from the Java runtime's corresponding upstream release:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/protocolbuffers/protobuf/v32.1/LICENSE

The additional Protobuf Java copyright entry is:
META-INF/third-party/com/google/protobuf/protobuf-java/4.32.1/COPYRIGHT
It retains Copyright 2008 Google Inc. from the BSD license,
Copyright 2023 Google Inc. from java_features.proto in the binary jar,
and Copyright 2024 Google LLC. from GeneratedMessageV3.java,
RepeatedFieldBuilderV3.java, and SingleFieldBuilderV3.java in the source jar.
The exact binary and source archives are:
https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/com/google/protobuf/protobuf-java/4.32.1/protobuf-java-4.32.1.jar
https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/com/google/protobuf/protobuf-java/4.32.1/protobuf-java-4.32.1-sources.jar
Protobuf Java Util has its BSD LICENSE only, not this additional COPYRIGHT.
